title: La piccola vedetta lombarda
author: Edmondo De Amicis
note: Lombardy, June 1859, during the war to drive the Austrians out of northern Italy: an Italian cavalry patrol meets a twelve-year-old boy alone by a farmhouse, and he becomes their "vedetta", their lookout. The story uses the passato remoto: when you hear "disse" or "fu", think "said", "was". "Officer" is sometimes in the old form "uffiziale", for "ufficiale".

segments.fr: Nel mille ottocento cinquantanove,
segments.en: In eighteen fifty-nine,

segments.fr: durante la guerra per la liberazione della Lombardia,
segments.en: during the war for the liberation of Lombardy,

segments.fr: pochi giorni dopo la battaglia di Solferino e San Martino,
segments.en: a few days after the battle of Solferino and San Martino,

segments.fr: vinta dai Francesi e dagli Italiani contro gli Austriaci,
segments.en: won by the French and the Italians against the Austrians,

segments.fr: in una bella mattinata del mese di giugno,
segments.en: on a fine morning in the month of June,

segments.fr: un piccolo drappello di cavalleggieri di Saluzzo
segments.en: a small troop of light cavalrymen from Saluzzo

segments.fr: andava di lento passo, per un sentiero solitario, verso il nemico,
segments.en: was going at a slow pace, along a lonely path, towards the enemy,

segments.fr: esplorando attentamente la campagna.
segments.en: carefully scouting the countryside.

segments.fr: Guidavano il drappello un ufficiale e un sergente,
segments.en: The troop was led by an officer and a sergeant,

segments.fr: e tutti guardavano lontano, davanti a sé, con occhio fisso, muti,
segments.en: and all were looking far ahead of them, with a fixed eye, silent,

segments.fr: preparati a veder da un momento all'altro
segments.en: ready to see at any moment

segments.fr: biancheggiare fra gli alberi le divise degli avamposti nemici.
segments.en: the uniforms of the enemy outposts showing white among the trees.

segments.fr: Arrivarono così a una casetta rustica, circondata di frassini,
segments.en: So they came to a little farmhouse, surrounded by ash trees,

segments.fr: davanti alla quale se ne stava tutto solo
segments.en: in front of which, all alone, stood

segments.fr: un ragazzo d'una dozzina d'anni,
segments.en: a boy of about twelve,

segments.fr: che scortecciava un piccolo ramo con un coltello,
segments.en: who was peeling the bark off a small branch with a knife,

segments.fr: per farsene un bastoncino;
segments.en: to make himself a little stick;

segments.fr: da una finestra della casa spenzolava una larga bandiera tricolore;
segments.en: from a window of the house hung a wide tricolour flag;

segments.fr: dentro non c'era nessuno:
segments.en: inside there was no one:

segments.fr: i contadini, messa fuori la bandiera, erano scappati,
segments.en: the peasants, after putting out the flag, had run away,

segments.fr: per paura degli Austriaci.
segments.en: for fear of the Austrians.

segments.fr: Appena visti i cavalleggieri,
segments.en: As soon as he saw the cavalrymen,

segments.fr: il ragazzo buttò via il bastone e si levò il berretto.
segments.en: the boy threw away the stick and took off his cap.

segments.fr: Era un bel ragazzo, di viso ardito,
segments.en: He was a handsome boy, with a bold face,

segments.fr: con gli occhi grandi e celesti, coi capelli biondi e lunghi;
segments.en: with big light-blue eyes, with long blond hair;

segments.fr: era in maniche di camicia, e mostrava il petto nudo.
segments.en: he was in his shirtsleeves, and his chest was bare.

segments.fr: «Che fai qui?» gli domandò l'ufficiale, fermando il cavallo.
segments.en: "What are you doing here?" the officer asked him, stopping his horse.

segments.fr: «Perchè non sei fuggito con la tua famiglia?»
segments.en: "Why didn't you run away with your family?"

segments.fr: «Io non ho famiglia», rispose il ragazzo.
segments.en: "I don't have a family," the boy answered.

segments.fr: «Sono un trovatello. Lavoro un po' per tutti.
segments.en: "I'm a foundling. I work a bit for everyone.

segments.fr: Son rimasto qui per veder la guerra.»
segments.en: I stayed here to see the war."

segments.fr: «Hai visto passare degli Austriaci?»
segments.en: "Have you seen any Austrians go by?"

segments.fr: «No, da tre giorni.»
segments.en: "No, not for three days."

segments.fr: L'ufficiale stette un poco pensando;
segments.en: The officer stood thinking for a moment;

segments.fr: poi saltò giù da cavallo,
segments.en: then he jumped down from his horse,

segments.fr: e lasciati i soldati lì, rivolti verso il nemico,
segments.en: and leaving the soldiers there, facing the enemy,

segments.fr: entrò nella casa e salì sul tetto...
segments.en: he went into the house and climbed onto the roof...

segments.fr: La casa era bassa;
segments.en: The house was low;

segments.fr: dal tetto non si vedeva che un piccolo tratto di campagna.
segments.en: from the roof you could see only a small stretch of countryside.

segments.fr: «Bisogna salir sugli alberi», disse l'ufficiale, e discese.
segments.en: "We have to climb the trees," said the officer, and he came down.

segments.fr: Proprio davanti all'aia si drizzava un frassino altissimo e sottile,
segments.en: Right in front of the farmyard rose a very tall, thin ash tree,

segments.fr: che dondolava la vetta nell'azzurro.
segments.en: which swayed its top in the blue sky.

segments.fr: L'ufficiale rimase un po' sopra pensiero,
segments.en: The officer stayed lost in thought for a while,

segments.fr: guardando ora l'albero ora i soldati;
segments.en: looking now at the tree, now at the soldiers;

segments.fr: poi tutt'a un tratto domandò al ragazzo:
segments.en: then all of a sudden he asked the boy:

segments.fr: «Hai buona vista, tu, monello?»
segments.en: "Have you got good eyes, you, kid?"

segments.fr: «Io?» rispose il ragazzo.
segments.en: "Me?" answered the boy.

segments.fr: «Io vedo un passerotto lontano un miglio.»
segments.en: "I can see a sparrow a mile away."

segments.fr: «Saresti buono a salire in cima a quell'albero?»
segments.en: "Would you be able to climb to the top of that tree?"

segments.fr: «In cima a quell'albero? io?
segments.en: "To the top of that tree? Me?

segments.fr: In mezzo minuto ci salgo.»
segments.en: I'll climb it in half a minute."

segments.fr: «E sapresti dirmi quello che vedi di lassù,
segments.en: "And could you tell me what you see from up there,

segments.fr: se c'è soldati austriaci da quella parte,
segments.en: whether there are Austrian soldiers over that way,

segments.fr: nuvoli di polvere, fucili che luccicano, cavalli?»
segments.en: clouds of dust, rifles that glitter, horses?"

segments.fr: «Sicuro che saprei.»
segments.en: "Sure I could."

segments.fr: «Che cosa vuoi per farmi questo servizio?»
segments.en: "What do you want for doing me this service?"

segments.fr: «Che cosa voglio?» disse il ragazzo sorridendo.
segments.en: "What do I want?" said the boy, smiling.

segments.fr: «Niente. Bella cosa!
segments.en: "Nothing. Some idea!

segments.fr: E poi... se fosse per i tedeschi, a nessun patto;
segments.en: And besides... if it were for the Germans, not on any terms;

segments.fr: ma per i nostri! Io sono lombardo.»
segments.en: but for our side! I'm from Lombardy."

segments.fr: «Bene. Va su dunque.»
segments.en: "Good. Go on up, then."

segments.fr: «Un momento, che mi levi le scarpe.»
segments.en: "One moment, let me take off my shoes."

segments.fr: Si levò le scarpe, si strinse la cinghia dei calzoni,
segments.en: He took off his shoes, tightened the belt of his trousers,

segments.fr: buttò nell'erba il berretto e abbracciò il tronco del frassino.
segments.en: threw his cap in the grass and hugged the trunk of the ash tree.

segments.fr: «Ma bada....» esclamò l'uffiziale,
segments.en: "But be careful...." exclaimed the officer,

segments.fr: facendo l'atto di trattenerlo,
segments.en: making a move to hold him back,

segments.fr: come preso da un timore improvviso.
segments.en: as if seized by a sudden fear.

segments.fr: Il ragazzo si voltò a guardarlo,
segments.en: The boy turned to look at him,

segments.fr: coi suoi begli occhi celesti, in atto interrogativo.
segments.en: with his beautiful light-blue eyes, questioningly.

segments.fr: «Niente», disse l'uffiziale; «va su.»
segments.en: "Nothing," said the officer; "go on up."

segments.fr: Il ragazzo andò su, come un gatto.
segments.en: The boy went up, like a cat.

segments.fr: «Guardate davanti a voi», gridò l'uffiziale ai soldati.
segments.en: "Look ahead of you," the officer shouted to the soldiers.

segments.fr: In pochi momenti il ragazzo fu sulla cima dell'albero,
segments.en: In a few moments the boy was at the top of the tree,

segments.fr: avviticchiato al fusto, con le gambe fra le foglie,
segments.en: wrapped tight around the trunk, with his legs among the leaves,

segments.fr: ma col busto scoperto,
segments.en: but with his upper body in the open,

segments.fr: e il sole gli batteva sul capo biondo, che pareva d'oro.
segments.en: and the sun beat down on his blond head, which looked like gold.

segments.fr: L'uffiziale lo vedeva appena, tanto era piccino lassù.
segments.en: The officer could barely see him, he was so tiny up there.

segments.fr: «Guarda dritto e lontano», gridò l'uffiziale.
segments.en: "Look straight ahead and far away," shouted the officer.

segments.fr: Il ragazzo, per veder meglio,
segments.en: The boy, to see better,

segments.fr: staccò la mano destra dall'albero e se la mise alla fronte.
segments.en: took his right hand off the tree and put it to his forehead.

segments.fr: «Che cosa vedi?» domandò l'uffiziale.
segments.en: "What do you see?" asked the officer.

segments.fr: Il ragazzo chinò il viso verso di lui,
segments.en: The boy bent his face down towards him,

segments.fr: e facendosi portavoce della mano, rispose:
segments.en: and making a megaphone of his hand, he answered:

segments.fr: «Due uomini a cavallo, sulla strada bianca.»
segments.en: "Two men on horseback, on the white road."

segments.fr: «A che distanza di qui?»
segments.en: "How far from here?"

segments.fr: «Mezzo miglio.»
segments.en: "Half a mile."

segments.fr: «Movono?»
segments.en: "Are they moving?"

segments.fr: «Son fermi.»
segments.en: "They're standing still."

segments.fr: «Che altro vedi?» domandò l'ufficiale, dopo un momento di silenzio.
segments.en: "What else do you see?" asked the officer, after a moment of silence.

segments.fr: «Guarda a destra.»
segments.en: "Look to the right."

segments.fr: Il ragazzo guardò a destra.
segments.en: The boy looked to the right.

segments.fr: Poi disse: «Vicino al cimitero, tra gli alberi,
segments.en: Then he said: "Near the cemetery, among the trees,

segments.fr: c'è qualche cosa che luccica. Paiono baionette.»
segments.en: there's something that glitters. They look like bayonets."

segments.fr: «Vedi gente?»
segments.en: "Do you see people?"

segments.fr: «No. Saran nascosti nel grano.»
segments.en: "No. They must be hidden in the wheat."

segments.fr: In quel momento un fischio di palla acutissimo passò alto per l'aria
segments.en: At that moment the very shrill whistle of a bullet passed high through the air

segments.fr: e andò a morire lontano dietro alla casa.
segments.en: and died away far behind the house.

segments.fr: «Scendi, ragazzo!» gridò l'ufficiale.
segments.en: "Come down, boy!" shouted the officer.

segments.fr: «T'han visto. Non voglio altro. Vien giù.»
segments.en: "They've seen you. I don't want anything more. Come down."

segments.fr: «Io non ho paura», rispose il ragazzo.
segments.en: "I'm not afraid," answered the boy.

segments.fr: «Scendi...» ripeté l'ufficiale, «che altro vedi, a sinistra?»
segments.en: "Come down..." repeated the officer, "what else do you see, to the left?"

segments.fr: «A sinistra?»
segments.en: "To the left?"

segments.fr: «Sì, a sinistra.»
segments.en: "Yes, to the left."

segments.fr: Il ragazzo sporse il capo a sinistra;
segments.en: The boy leaned his head out to the left;

segments.fr: in quel punto un altro fischio più acuto e più basso del primo
segments.en: at that instant another whistle, sharper and lower than the first,

segments.fr: tagliò l'aria.
segments.en: cut through the air.

segments.fr: Il ragazzo si riscosse tutto.
segments.en: The boy gave a violent start.

segments.fr: «Accidenti!» esclamò. «L'hanno proprio con me!»
segments.en: "Damn it!" he exclaimed. "They're really after me!"

segments.fr: La palla gli era passata poco lontano.
segments.en: The bullet had passed close to him.

segments.fr: «A basso!» gridò l'ufficiale, imperioso e irritato.
segments.en: "Get down!" shouted the officer, commanding and angry.

segments.fr: «Scendo subito», rispose il ragazzo.
segments.en: "I'm coming down right away," answered the boy.

segments.fr: «Ma l'albero mi ripara, non dubiti.
segments.en: "But the tree shields me, don't worry.

segments.fr: A sinistra, vuole sapere?»
segments.en: To the left, you want to know?"

segments.fr: «A sinistra», rispose l'ufficiale; «ma scendi.»
segments.en: "To the left," answered the officer; "but come down."

segments.fr: «A sinistra», gridò il ragazzo, sporgendo il busto da quella parte,
segments.en: "To the left," shouted the boy, leaning his body out that way,

segments.fr: «dove c'è una cappella, mi par di veder...»
segments.en: "where there's a chapel, I think I see..."

segments.fr: Un terzo fischio rabbioso passò in alto,
segments.en: A third furious whistle passed high up,

segments.fr: e quasi ad un punto si vide il ragazzo venir giù,
segments.en: and almost at the same instant the boy was seen coming down,

segments.fr: trattenendosi per un tratto al fusto ed ai rami,
segments.en: holding on for a moment to the trunk and the branches,

segments.fr: e poi precipitando a capo fitto colle braccia aperte.
segments.en: and then plunging headfirst with his arms spread open.

segments.fr: «Maledizione!» gridò l'uffiziale, accorrendo.
segments.en: "Curse it!" shouted the officer, running up.

segments.fr: Il ragazzo batté la schiena per terra
segments.en: The boy hit the ground with his back

segments.fr: e restò disteso con le braccia larghe, supino;
segments.en: and lay stretched out with his arms wide, flat on his back;

segments.fr: un rigagnolo di sangue gli sgorgava dal petto, a sinistra.
segments.en: a trickle of blood was gushing from his chest, on the left.

segments.fr: Il sergente e due soldati saltaron giù da cavallo;
segments.en: The sergeant and two soldiers jumped down from their horses;

segments.fr: l'uffiziale si chinò e gli aprì la camicia:
segments.en: the officer bent down and opened his shirt:

segments.fr: la palla gli era entrata nel polmone sinistro.
segments.en: the bullet had gone into his left lung.

segments.fr: «È morto!» esclamò l'uffiziale.
segments.en: "He's dead!" exclaimed the officer.

segments.fr: «No, vive!» rispose il sergente.
segments.en: "No, he's alive!" answered the sergeant.

segments.fr: «Ah! povero ragazzo! bravo ragazzo!» gridò l'uffiziale;
segments.en: "Ah! poor boy! brave boy!" shouted the officer;

segments.fr: «coraggio! coraggio!»
segments.en: "courage! courage!"

segments.fr: Ma mentre gli diceva coraggio
segments.en: But while he was telling him courage

segments.fr: e gli premeva il fazzoletto sulla ferita,
segments.en: and pressing his handkerchief on the wound,

segments.fr: il ragazzo stralunò gli occhi e abbandonò il capo: era morto.
segments.en: the boy rolled his eyes and let his head fall: he was dead.

segments.fr: L'uffiziale impallidì, e lo guardò fisso per un momento;
segments.en: The officer went pale, and stared at him for a moment;

segments.fr: poi lo adagiò col capo sull'erba;
segments.en: then he laid him down gently with his head on the grass;

segments.fr: s'alzò, e stette a guardarlo;
segments.en: he got up, and stood looking at him;

segments.fr: anche il sergente e i due soldati, immobili, lo guardavano:
segments.en: the sergeant and the two soldiers too, motionless, were looking at him:

segments.fr: gli altri stavan rivolti verso il nemico.
segments.en: the others stayed turned towards the enemy.

segments.fr: «Povero ragazzo!» ripeté tristemente l'uffiziale.
segments.en: "Poor boy!" the officer repeated sadly.

segments.fr: «Povero e bravo ragazzo!»
segments.en: "Poor, brave boy!"

segments.fr: Poi s'avvicinò alla casa,
segments.en: Then he went up to the house,

segments.fr: levò dalla finestra la bandiera tricolore,
segments.en: took the tricolour flag down from the window,

segments.fr: e la distese come un drappo funebre sul piccolo morto,
segments.en: and spread it like a funeral cloth over the little dead boy,

segments.fr: lasciandogli il viso scoperto.
segments.en: leaving his face uncovered.

segments.fr: Il sergente raccolse a fianco del morto
segments.en: The sergeant gathered beside the dead boy

segments.fr: le scarpe, il berretto, il bastoncino e il coltello.
segments.en: the shoes, the cap, the little stick and the knife.

segments.fr: Stettero ancora un momento silenziosi;
segments.en: They stayed silent a moment longer;

segments.fr: poi l'ufficiale si rivolse al sergente e gli disse:
segments.en: then the officer turned to the sergeant and said to him:

segments.fr: «Lo manderemo a pigliare dall'ambulanza;
segments.en: "We'll send the field hospital to pick him up;

segments.fr: è morto da soldato: lo seppelliranno i soldati.»
segments.en: he died like a soldier: soldiers will bury him."

segments.fr: Detto questo mandò un bacio al morto con un atto della mano,
segments.en: Having said this, he blew a kiss to the dead boy with a gesture of his hand,

segments.fr: e gridò: «A cavallo.»
segments.en: and shouted: "Mount up."

segments.fr: Tutti balzarono in sella, il drappello si riunì
segments.en: They all leapt into the saddle, the troop gathered again

segments.fr: e riprese il suo cammino.
segments.en: and went on its way.

segments.fr: E poche ore dopo il piccolo morto ebbe i suoi onori di guerra.
segments.en: And a few hours later the little dead boy had his military honours.

segments.fr: Al tramontar del sole,
segments.en: At sunset,

segments.fr: tutta la linea degli avamposti italiani s'avanzava verso il nemico,
segments.en: the whole line of Italian outposts was advancing towards the enemy,

segments.fr: e per lo stesso cammino percorso la mattina dal drappello di cavalleria,
segments.en: and along the same path taken that morning by the cavalry troop,

segments.fr: procedeva su due file un grosso battaglione di bersaglieri,
segments.en: a large battalion of bersaglieri was marching in two lines,

segments.fr: il quale, pochi giorni innanzi,
segments.en: which, a few days before,

segments.fr: aveva valorosamente rigato di sangue il colle di San Martino.
segments.en: had bravely streaked the hill of San Martino with blood.

segments.fr: La notizia della morte del ragazzo
segments.en: The news of the boy's death

segments.fr: era già corsa fra quei soldati prima che lasciassero gli accampamenti.
segments.en: had already spread among those soldiers before they left their camps.

segments.fr: Il sentiero, fiancheggiato da un rigagnolo,
segments.en: The path, running alongside a little stream,

segments.fr: passava a pochi passi di distanza dalla casa.
segments.en: passed a few steps away from the house.

segments.fr: Quando i primi ufficiali del battaglione
segments.en: When the first officers of the battalion

segments.fr: videro il piccolo cadavere disteso ai piedi del frassino
segments.en: saw the little body lying at the foot of the ash tree

segments.fr: e coperto dalla bandiera tricolore, lo salutarono con la sciabola;
segments.en: and covered by the tricolour flag, they saluted him with their sabres;

segments.fr: e uno di essi si chinò sopra la sponda del rigagnolo,
segments.en: and one of them bent over the bank of the little stream,

segments.fr: ch'era tutta fiorita, strappò due fiori e glieli gettò.
segments.en: which was all in flower, picked two flowers and threw them to him.

segments.fr: Allora tutti i bersaglieri, via via che passavano,
segments.en: Then all the bersaglieri, one after another as they passed,

segments.fr: strapparono dei fiori e li gettarono al morto.
segments.en: picked some flowers and threw them to the dead boy.

segments.fr: In pochi minuti il ragazzo fu coperto di fiori,
segments.en: In a few minutes the boy was covered with flowers,

segments.fr: e ufficiali e soldati gli mandavan tutti un saluto passando:
segments.en: and officers and soldiers all sent him a farewell as they passed:

segments.fr: «Bravo, piccolo lombardo!» «Addio, ragazzo!»
segments.en: "Well done, little Lombard!" "Goodbye, boy!"

segments.fr: «A te, biondino!» «Evviva!» «Gloria!» «Addio!»
segments.en: "This is for you, little blond boy!" "Hurrah!" "Glory!" "Goodbye!"

segments.fr: un altro andò a baciargli la fronte.
segments.en: another went to kiss his forehead.

segments.fr: E i fiori continuavano a piovergli sui piedi nudi,
segments.en: And the flowers kept raining down on his bare feet,

segments.fr: sul petto insanguinato, sul capo biondo.
segments.en: on his bloodstained chest, on his blond head.

segments.fr: Ed egli se ne dormiva là nell'erba, ravvolto nella sua bandiera,
segments.en: And he lay sleeping there in the grass, wrapped in his flag,

segments.fr: col viso bianco e quasi sorridente, povero ragazzo,
segments.en: with his face white and almost smiling, poor boy,

segments.fr: come se sentisse quei saluti,
segments.en: as if he could hear those farewells,

segments.fr: e fosse contento d'aver dato la vita per la sua Lombardia.
